answer_1.quote: We introduce PLLuM-Align, the first human‑curated Polish preference dataset… It comprises carefully curated prompts designed to reflect various aspects of the Polish language and culture… The dataset includes fact‑based QA prompts, text generation tasks, and multi‑turn dialogs.
answer_1.outputs: Model‑generated responses that are ranked, rated, or used in multi‑turn dialogs for alignment evaluation

answer_2.quote: The evaluation uses the LLM‑as‑a‑judge approach… Win‑Tie‑Rate (WTR) metric… Attack Success Rate (ASR)… False Reject Rate (FRR)… Llama‑Guard model was utilized to assess unsafe responses.

answer_3.quote: We employed Llama3.1‑70B (AI@Meta, 2024) as a strong language model to approximate human preference evaluations… The judge model uses detailed evaluation guidelines and gold‑standard references.

answer_4.quote: Annotators evaluated each response on a 5‑point Likert scale across seven criteria: truthfulness, linguistic correctness, safety, fairness, conciseness, coherence & reasoning, helpfulness & instruction‑following.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators followed detailed guidelines specifying the seven evaluation criteria and used a 5‑point Likert scale for each criterion.
